dedupe_keys.name: vibration based monitoring of a small scale wind turbine blade under varying climate conditions part i an experimental benchmark

description: Ou, Yaowen and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The experimental Sonkyo benchmark supplies separate archives for thirteen case groups and twelve temperatures from minus fifteen to forty degrees Celsius. Each case-temperature archive contains observations from two sensor layouts. The source establishes a physical small-scale wind-blade vibration experiment for condition monitoring under varying climate conditions. It does not specify all damage states, signal channels or sample rates in the inspected description. The archive naming scheme identifies the published components, but no archive was opened and complete signal quality or availability within each component was not tested. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
